page.overview:
Who is Arcana Force 0 - The Fool?

Arcana Force 0 - The Fool is a character version of the card, "Arcana Force 0 - The Fool". It appears in the video game Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's World Championship 2009: Stardust Accelerator.

Arcana Force 0 - The Fool uses a Fairy Deck titled, "Rival Face Off".
